summary: Tested Importazione di massa end to end. Backend: 12 pytest cases, 10 pass. Covered model download (8 sheets, * on mandatory headers, prefill, SI/NO and cliente/fornitore validations), preview errors with row numbers, nothing written at preview, rejection of non-xlsx files, blocking of unbalanced saldi or saldi with different dates (confirm returns 400), confirm effects (party update keeps fields not in the sheet, listino replace with sconto 10+5, giacenza 10 at costo_medio 4.5, gestione_magazzino true, one AP/apertura entry with party_id on the rows, partite in scadenzario and scadenzario-passivo, active/passive payments plus over-residuo 400), second confirm 404, cross-tenant confirm 404, storico, operatore 403, DELETE company cleanup. Frontend: Playwright tests pass. The menu is hidden for operatore and the route redirects, the admin menu opens /importazione, the model downloads, the bad-file preview shows errors and imp-bloccanti with the confirm button disabled, the good file imports and imp-esito shows, and the partita appears in /scadenzario. 2 real defects found (see below).

critical.issue: If the company's chart of accounts is not seeded yet (new company that never opened Contabilita), `conti` is empty and the check `if conti and c not in conti` lets ANY conto through in preview (no errors, bloccanti=[]). On confirm, ensure_seed runs and coge._insert raises: the API returns 400 'Saldi contabili non registrati ... Le altre schede sono state importate'. The import is now partial: Clienti, Articoli, Listini and Giacenze are written, PartiteAperte are NOT (they come after SaldiContabili), and the batch is left in stato 'errore' and cannot be confirmed again. Re-uploading the corrected file then duplicates the stock carichi. Reproduced on a fresh company with conti 99.99.999/88.88.888.

minor.issue: These return 404 ('Fattura non trovata' / 'Fattura passiva non trovata') for partite_aperte ids, because only POST was extended to look in partite_aperte. Payments recorded on an imported partita can't be listed or deleted through PaymentsPanel.
The numero_display link of an imported partita goes to /fatture/{id} or /passive/{id}, which doesn't exist for partite_aperte, so the user hits a not-found page.
PartiteAperte: 'numero' is marked mandatory (*) but is not validated, so an empty numero is accepted. OBBLIGATORI is not enforced for this sheet.

Updates of existing parties and articles use `$set` with the raw sheet values. New records go through PartyIn/ArticleIn.model_dump(), so values a validator would normalise are written to existing records unnormalised. The confirm is also not atomic: an exception partway leaves the batch 'in_corso' forever.

Duplicate rows in the file (same P.IVA or codice) are both counted as 'nuovi'. Giacenze, SaldiContabili and PartiteAperte have no dedupe, so re-importing the same file creates duplicate carichi, apertura entries and partite.

integration_issues.issue: The document link points to a non-existent invoice page. Payment history for the partita can't be viewed because GET pagamenti returns 404.

issues: '1 errori' should be '1 errore' (plural used for a single error)
imp-esito lists sheets with 0 righe (Fornitori: 0 righe, Listini: 0 righe), which is noise
There is no UI for GET /api/importazione/storico (the history of imports)

action_items: In anteprima, call coge.ensure_seed(db, cid) before loading `conti` (or treat an empty chart of accounts as an error) so that invalid conti are flagged at preview. Consider validating SaldiContabili before writing the other sheets, or importing PartiteAperte before Saldi.
Make GET /api/invoices/{id}/pagamenti and GET /api/passive/{id}/pagamenti accept partite_aperte ids, the same way the POST endpoints do.
In Scadenzario, don't link imported partite (origine 'importazione') to /fatture or /passive. Show plain text or open the payments panel instead.
Optional: normalise update values through the PartyIn/ArticleIn validators; add a UI for storico; fix '1 errori'.
critical_code_review_comments: importazione.py line 234: `if conti and c not in conti` silently skips validation when the chart of accounts is empty.
The conferma flow is not transactional, so a failure partway leaves a partial import and a batch stuck in 'in_corso' or 'errore'.
The `_seeded` in-memory cache in contabilita.ensure_seed means a manual removal of coa_accounts is not re-seeded until the backend restarts (test-environment caveat).

success_rate.backend: 83% (10/12; the 2 failures are the defects above)

seed_data_creation: Only TEST_T47* / TEST_T47UI companies, users and sessions. Everything was removed afterwards (verified 0 companies, 0 import_batches, 0 partite_aperte).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_iteration47_importazione.py -n 0 (from /app/backend). Fixture setup calls GET /api/contabilita/conti to seed the chart of accounts for company A; company B is left unseeded on purpose, which reproduces the conto-validation bug. UI fixtures: python tests/ui_setup_t47.py setup|clean (cookie session_token=test_session_t47ui admin / test_session_t47ui_op operatore, localStorage fe_company_id=cid, files /tmp/t47_ok.xlsx and /tmp/t47_bad.xlsx).
rca of the issue: Unseeded chart of accounts: coa_accounts is seeded lazily (ensure_seed) only when accounting endpoints are used. anteprima reads coa_accounts without seeding, gets an empty map and skips the conto check. conferma seeds and then fails in coge._insert after the earlier sheets have been written. Repro: create a new company, upload only SaldiContabili with conti 99.99.999 / 88.88.888 balanced, then confirm -> 400 with a partial import. Fix: await coge.ensure_seed(db, cid) at the start of anteprima and remove the `conti and` short-circuit.
